title: 访问修饰符
problem_statement_md:
假设你是一名旅游经理，需要有一个国家及其首都的信息

给定程序，创建了**国家**对象，期望输出**国家名称**和**首都**，但代码出了问题。

请改变国家类**Country**中属性的访问修饰符，以正确输出信息。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Access Modifiers[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You're a tour manager and you need to have a list of countries along with its capitals.
You're given a program which creates [b]Country [/b]object and you should output the [b]name [/b]and the [b]capital[/b], but something goes wrong.

[b]Task[/b]
Change the access modifiers of the Country class fields in order to perform the required output.

[note]Use [b]public [/b]access modifier to provide access to any other classes.[/note]
hint_md: 使用 **public** 访问修饰符 允许来自任何其他类的访问。
